Subject: Eval kickoff: Acme Corp — next steps & scheduling

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Summary from today (TL;DR)
- Goal: run a 4-week evaluation of Redwood Inference to validate latency and cost impact on Acme's customer support summarization pipeline.
- Success criteria: average generation latency < 250ms at 512 tokens, cost per 1k tokens < $0.85, and identical or improved QA pass rates on our prompt set vs current vendor.
- Stakeholders: Alex (Product), Priya (Infra), Marissa (Customer Success), Neha (Solutions Eng)

Proposed next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (45–60m) to align on trial plan, access, and prompt/eval set. Suggested agenda:
1) Introductions and goals (5m)
2) Trial scope & success criteria (10m)
3) Trial technical plan (access, data, infra) (20m)
4) Prompt set & eval methodology (10m)
5) Next steps & owners (5m)

Availability: are you and Priya available for one of the slots below?
- Thu May 6: 9:00–10:00am PT
- Thu May 6: 1:00–2:00pm PT
- Fri May 7: 10:00–11:00am PT

I've attached a short draft trial plan and a sample prompt set to give context (Acme_eval_trial_plan_v1.pdf, prompt_set_sample.csv). If those look OK I can send a calendar invite and loop in our infra contact with minimal access instructions.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142
